name: report_problem
description: Report a wrong curated item (kind fix: a pack word, a curated module, scene, story, reading, villager line or dictionary entry the learner's own copy can't fix) or a wish for the app (kind wish: a mechanic, a screen) to Lani's GitHub discussions. The app looks it up first (an existing report gets the learner's vote) and posts only after the learner confirms ("Send to Lani's discussions?"); the result says what happened. The discussions are public: nothing personal, no chat quotes, no names of the learner or their family, none of their mistakes; only the item, what is wrong and the fix. title names the item, e.g. "Fix: pack praznik-trgatev, word škarje" (a wish: "Idea: …"). item: the item's source as the app sent it (about_exercise.source: its kind and ids). native_check: Slovene a machine wrote that a native speaker should check. Fix what you can for the learner first (card, publish tools).

item.description: The item's source as the app sent it (about_exercise.source): kind and ids, e.g. {"kind": "pack", "pack_id": "…", "word_id": "…"}.

what_is_wrong.description: What is wrong (fix) or what is wished for and why (wish). Nothing personal.

suggested_fix.description: The fix, as exact as you can (the right word, translation or choice).

native_check.description: Slovene a machine wrote: a native speaker should check it.
